brief: Council brief 022 (D122 #1); SYNTHESIS_022.md section 6, EXP-6 PIPE-LOO, rank #1
label: OBSERVED (completion series) + DERIVED (ratio, LOO prediction, error, median, share)
statement: Measurement audit of an observed series. The lower->upper one-stage transition ratio is tested as a PREDICTIVE object (out-of-sample, leave-one-out, within country) and is NOT asserted to cause anything. No causal claim; no direction claim. D63 remains UNABLE as to cause. No C1-C4 reopening; EXP-1 is not re-scored (same pairing rule, different estimand). No threshold, bar, pairing rule or verdict string was changed after results; no re-fit; no second estimand. VERDICT: PREDICTIVE (3/4 countries pass).

verdict.rule: per country PASS iff median|LOO error| <= 3.0 pp AND >=75% of pairs within +/-5 pp; PREDICTIVE iff >=3/4 countries pass; NOT PREDICTIVE iff <=2/4
verdict.branch_fired: PREDICTIVE -> per-system kappa becomes a declared input (never fitted); the ceiling question becomes 'what sets kappa?'; the D115 reclassification is NOT downgraded. D63 stays UNABLE as to cause.
verdict.non_entrant_reason: zero completion_lower_secondary / completion_upper_secondary rows in the frozen file; cannot enter; no proxy numerator (D118); never imputed

predeclaration.verbatim_source: 08_council/brief_022/SYNTHESIS_022.md section 6 EXP-6, heading and items 1-7, quoted character-for-character and verified line-by-line against the source

declared_parameters.tie_break: nearest lower year to t-3 within +/-1 y, ties toward the earlier year (min over (|y-target|, y), the EXP-1 build_pairs convention)
declared_parameters.loo_estimator: median of the country's other pairs' ratios; prediction = that median * the pair's own lower value; kappa never fitted, never pooled across countries

results.brief_calibration_note: all four medians reproduce to 2 dp and all four pair counts reproduce exactly; recorded as agreement about the construction, never used to choose a rule

determinism.note: no RNG, no clock-dependent output in any result file; the only non-deterministic field anywhere is the build time of this manifest, which is not a result

declared_limits: 43 pairs across 4 systems; 16 of 59 upper years dropped by the declared pairing rule
verdict sits exactly at the declared boundary (3 of 4 required); no headroom
HKG and JPN have zero completion pairs and cannot enter; no proxy numerator, no imputation
KOR's pass is near an arithmetic identity at saturation (both series ~100%); PHL, KHM and CHN carry the informative content
PHL's pass rests mainly on 2003-2017 pairs; the two late pairs (2023, 2024) are in band but upper 2022 is dropped by the rule
completion-only measure (D118, one admissible numerator); no GER substitution
realised lags run 2-4 years under the +/-1 y tolerance, so 'one-stage' is approximate per pair
pooled (all-43) medians in the results CSV are DESCRIPTIVE only and carry no verdict
closed_claims: does not re-score EXP-1 (out-of-sample prediction, not in-band share)
no causal claim; no direction claim
D63 remains UNABLE as to cause
no re-fit, no re-parameterisation, no second estimand
does not re-test or re-run CEIL-ATTRIB ablations, the generator, or any WT/DT cell
